# homesight API

> Read-only data for deciding which Swedish apartment to buy, built for LLM agents. Two layers: the market as Booli publishes it (apartments and houses for sale, completed sales, and område/kommun/city statistics) for Stockholm, Nacka, Solna and Tyresö; and, for a small set of bostadsrättsföreningar (BRFs, housing cooperatives), figures extracted from their own annual reports (årsredovisningar) and verified, each linked to the page it came from.

All endpoints are GET, public, and return JSON (this file is Markdown). Amounts are SEK, areas m², fees per month. The full contract, with every field's unit and meaning, is the OpenAPI spec.

## Docs

- [OpenAPI spec]({BASE}/openapi.json): every endpoint, parameter, sort and field

## Market (Booli snapshot)

- [GET /advertisements]({BASE}/advertisements): listings for sale, at most 10 per request. Pick a `sort` that matches the goal (e.g. `price_asc`, `brf_loan_asc`) and narrow with filters (`kommun`, `omrade`, `min_rooms`, `max_price`, `brf_org_number`, `near_lat`/`near_lng`/`radius_m`, ...) instead of paging. Each row is self-contained: the listing, its BRF (debt, fees, price and fee trends, turnover), and the averages of its område, kommun and city for the same type of home.
- [GET /kommuns]({BASE}/kommuns): the kommuns covered, with listing counts, asking and sold kr/m² per type of home, avgift and loan per m², turnover, trends and forecasts, and sold kr/m² per year and type (`price_stats`). Use it to learn the exact `kommun` values.
- [GET /areas]({BASE}/areas): the same per område (`?kommun=`, `?name_search=`); the values of the `omrade` filter.
- [GET /cities]({BASE}/cities): the same for the city (Stockholm: every kommun in Stockholms län that is covered).
- [GET /sales/stats/avg-price-per-sqm]({BASE}/sales/stats/avg-price-per-sqm): average sold kr/m² over completed sales, optionally `?year=` and `?rooms=`.

## BRFs

- [GET /brfs]({BASE}/brfs): one row per BRF with an apartment for sale (about 3 100), at most 10 per request: Booli's facts, loan per m², price and avgift history with trends and forecasts, turnover, share for sale, the current listings, and its område/kommun/city benchmarks. Same contract as the Real Estate Data API; filters `brf_name_search`, `kommun`, `omrade`, `min_brf_units`, ... and sorts `loan_asc`, `price_trend_5y_desc`, ...
- `has_report=true`: only the BRFs whose annual reports are extracted and verified (listed even when nothing is for sale). Their rows also carry `brf_report_*` (latest verified year: loans, cash, fees, costs and interest per m², ground rent), `brf_land_tenure` and `brf_stambyte_*`.
- [GET /brfs/{orgnr}]({BASE}/brfs/712400-1467): one BRF's row plus `report` (size, build years, land tenure, reports held and verified, stambyte assessment; null without extracted reports).
- [GET /brfs/{orgnr}/financials]({BASE}/brfs/712400-1467/financials): every verified fiscal year: income, costs, interest, loans, cash, per-m² figures and ratios (e.g. interest as a share of fees). `?include=values` adds where each number is printed in the report (file, page).

## Caveats

- Market data is a snapshot, not live: listings were captured August to October 2026 and sales run to July 2026. A listing may already be sold.
- Booli's BRF figures (`brf_total_loan_kr`, `brf_loan_per_m2`, `brf_economy`, ...) are as Booli shows them, unverified; `brf_report_*`, `report` and /brfs/{orgnr}/financials are from the annual reports and verified. Prefer the verified figures where both exist.
- Schools: the five nearest school units (Skolverket's socio-economic index 2023–2026: higher = harder intake), their averages and a 2029 projection, on every listing and per område/kommun/city. Filter with `min_school_index*`, sort with `school_*`.
- An empty result means nothing matched in the covered kommuns, not that nothing exists.
